channel.title: Vienna Public Transport — Disruptions & Commuter Info
channel.description: Active disruptions, construction works and restrictions from official sources (Wiener Linien, ÖBB, VOR/VAO, City of Vienna).

item.title: Wien Hauptbahnhof ↔ Wien Meidling
item.description: Because of a damaged bridge by a traffic accident, no trains can run between Wien Hbf (U) and Wien Meidling station (U) until approx. 21:45. [Since 21:12]
item.content:encoded:

[Since 21:12]

item.title: U6: Neue Donau, no stopping direction Floridsdorf
item.description: Due to renovation of the platform, line U6 stops the station Neue Donau U only in the direction of Siebenhirten U. You can reach Neue Donau with U6 from Floridsdorf. [Until 31.12.]
